title: FP-MCP-316 Functional Test Result
claim: The live FP-MCP-316 guarded executor successfully advanced the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple through fresh approval, fresh operator-local clearance, fresh runner capability observation, and scoped execution enablement creation, then stopped before runner start, approval consumption, OpenCode start, or canary execution.
summary: A fresh scoped approval was recorded under FP-MCP-317, committed at b3a9a59, and validated as usable for the FP-MCP-295 tuple. The live guarded executor first created/replaced operator-local clearance CLEARANCE-20260704T182447350Z-35c8785e. A fresh remote runner capabilities observation was read at 2026-07-04T18:24:51.882Z. The live guarded executor then selected PREVIEW_SCOPED_ENABLEMENT, internally previewed the scoped enablement manifest, and created scoped execution enablement ENABLEMENT-20260704T182458075Z-bf415295. The executor boundary reported PREVIEW_AND_CREATE_SCOPED_ENABLEMENT with enablementCreated=true and no runner-start, approval-consumption, OpenCode-start, or canary-run side effects.
caveats: The local clearance and enablement were intentionally short-lived and should be treated as expired for future work.
The remote runner capability observation contacted only the capabilities endpoint, not the runner start endpoint.
This test does not prove runner start; runner start remains out of scope and requires a later packet.
boundaries: No runner start endpoint was contacted.
No final runner-start gate was invoked.
Scoped enablement was the intended and final stop point for this test.
observedResult: The live FP-MCP-316 guarded executor successfully advanced the FP-MCP-295 canary tuple through fresh approval, fresh operator-local clearance, fresh runner capability observation, and scoped execution enablement creation, then stopped before runner start, approval consumption, OpenCode start, or canary execution.
